findings.title: Task completion can return before the parent continuation
findings.description: A task notification arriving before the original result clears the active ledger, causing dispatch to return without reading the parent’s queued continuation. Reproduced with `ScriptedClient`: dispatch returned `"Waiting"` after one receive call, leaving `"Finished artifact"` unread. Track pending continuations separately from running tasks and add this ordering as a regression test.

findings.title: Background timeout interrupts active foreground continuations
findings.description: The timeout selected before reading a continuation remains active throughout that turn, even after its task-completion notification clears the ledger. Reproduced a continuation that emitted `"Working"` then paused: dispatch returned partial text without its final result, logging a timeout with no tasks to stop. Disable the background-only timer when foreground continuation begins.

findings.title: Settings lookup and SDK execution target different directories
findings.description: Configuration is resolved against the supplied `cwd`, but SDK agents receive `cwd=None` and execute in the process directory. When these differ, one project’s memory/user-settings policy controls a session loading another project’s settings and memory. Use one effective directory for configuration and SDK execution, or reject mismatched directories explicitly.

findings.title: Background timeout accepts invalid durations
findings.description: The timeout is not validated as a positive, non-boolean integer. Verified that `0`, `-1`, `False`, and `True` all pass the current read path. Nonpositive values can immediately cancel waiting and stop healthy agents; booleans become zero/one-second limits. Reject these values at the configuration boundary and test both CLI and TOML inputs.
